required_columns.description: Globally unique raw observation identifier.
Study-scoped primary-human-hepatocyte donor identifier.
Calibration, internal validation, or independent held-out assignment.
Stable primary-study identifier such as DOI, PMID, or repository accession.
Exact table, figure, supplement, repository file, and row locator.
Must be Homo sapiens for this intake.
Exact primary-human-hepatocyte preparation and donor context.
Exact 2D, sandwich, spheroid, organoid, precision-cut, or in-situ context.
One declared physical memory substrate contract identifier.
Measured physical compartment or membrane domain.
Locus, protein, organelle state, metabolite store, or other directly assayed carrier.
Identifier joining matched phases of one donor-resolved experiment.
Baseline, write, washout, persistence, response, division, or erasure phase.
Physical substrate, future response, inheritance, or erasure readout.
Exact exposure, perturbation, infection, diet, injury, or state transition.
Non-negative elapsed hours from the declared trigger start.
Exact assay and processing pipeline.
Exact measured molecular or functional endpoint.
One finite raw numeric observation, never a reconstructed cohort mean.
Original source unit without implicit conversion.
Biological replicate identifier; it must not be treated as a new donor.
Exact cell, viable-cell, protein, DNA, area, volume, or other denominator.

conditional_columns.description: Numeric trigger amount when the trigger has a quantitative magnitude.
Original trigger unit; required whenever trigger_value is present.
Elapsed hours at verified trigger removal or washout.
Elapsed hours after verified trigger removal; required for persistence follow-up.
Exact second challenge; required for rechallenge-response observations.
Original second-challenge unit; required whenever rechallenge_value is present.
Measured lineage generation for a division-follow-up observation.
Measured parent identifier for lineage-resolved inheritance.
